goal: Generate a main image for a classic seven-day road trip guide along Route 66 in America, suitable for landscape covers and long-format initial screens.
style: Weathered yellow map paper + screen printed flat color blocks, roadside elements with American highway comic flavor

title_section.title_text: Route 66 Seven Days · Western Light and Dust
title_section.subtitle: D1–D7 Towns, Canyons, until finally reaching the Pacific Sunset

stops: D1 Albuquerque: Old Town Neon and Hot Air Balloon Museum → Overnight at Route 66 Motel
D2 Petrified Forest and Painted Desert: Enter through east entrance for a day crossing, stay at Holbrook motel and take a photo with dinosaur statue
D3 Sedona Red Rock and Cathedral Rock: Short hike and sunset, stay overnight at a lodge beneath the red rocks
D4 Grand Canyon South Rim: Short walk at Mather Point or Bright Angel Trail, supplies at Tusayan
D5 Hoover Dam and Lake Mead overlook → End the day with a night tour of Las Vegas Boulevard
D6 Mojave Desert route: Route 66 Museum in Kingman → Filming on the desert highway from Amboy to Barstow
D7 Santa Monica Pier Route 66 End sign and Pacific sunset, return to airport or downtown
route.line_style: Orange-yellow thick solid line shows the main highway, white dashed line indicates optional scenic boulevard, star-shaped nails indicate lodging towns every night.

stop_illustrations: Hot air balloon, petrified wood, red rock, canyon cliffs, dam, neon casino, road sign, pier ferris wheel

side_panel.content_type: One line each for daily encouragement / hydration / sunset watching reminders

notes: Prepare double the drinking water and sunscreen for the desert segment.
The seasons of the Grand Canyon's north and south rims open differently; the image shows the south rim's regular line.
Las Vegas accommodation premium is high on weekends, should book in advance
Long no-service section from Kingman to Barstow, refuel when the gauge is half full.
